children: Authum Investment & Infrastructure has offloaded nearly Rs 184 crore worth of shares in Welspun Enterprises, an infrastructure developer and part of the Welspun Group, through open-market transactions on September 15.

Welspun Enterprises shares corrected 6.18 percent amid high volumes to close at Rs 737.60 on the National Stock Exchange, extending their downtrend for another session. Overall, the stock has corrected 9 percent over the last few days, particularly after rallying nearly 47 percent in the second half of August to hit a record high on September 4. The stock had maintained a higher high–higher low formation since April 2026.

Authum Investment & Infrastructure net sold 24.02 lakh shares, representing 1.73 percent of the company's paid-up equity, for Rs 183.8 crore. The shares were sold at an average price of Rs 765.02 apiece.
According to the June 2026 shareholding pattern, Authum Investment held a 3.59 percent stake, or 49.7 lakh shares, in Welspun Enterprises.

Meanwhile, Fidelity Securities Fund, through Fidelity Blue Chip Growth Fund, acquired 19.23 lakh shares, representing 1.38 percent of the company's paid-up equity, at Rs 765 per share. The transaction was valued at Rs 147.15 crore.

title: Authum Investment sells Rs 184 crore worth of Welspun Enterprises shares
